fee_notes: Royalty is tiered: 2% of Gross Sales to National Account/Key Account Customers, Farm Class Tires, and Excess Service Department Sales; 3.5%-5.0% of Adjusted Gross Sales per Royalty Matrix. Local Fund minimum 4% of monthly Gross Sales (currently reduced to 3.6%). National Marketing Fee currently 0.9% of Gross Sales (max 1%). National Auto Service Warranty/Roadside fee $75/store/month. RAC accounting services not less than $200/month if established.
